t: A federation of Guatemala, El Salvador, Honduras, Nicaragua and Costa Rica that broke away from Mexico in 1823.
Liberal reforms under Francisco Morazán angered the Church and rural communities, while the federal government lacked money and an army.
Rafael Carrera’s revolt in Guatemala and the secession of the states destroyed the union by 1841, though the dream of unity lived on.
dyk: The Central American federation abolished slavery in 1824, more than forty years before the United States did so.
ev: Guatemala City signs an act of independence from Spain
The Central American provinces are annexed to the First Mexican Empire
A congress declares the United Provinces of Central America independent
A federal constitution is adopted and slavery is abolished
Francisco Morazán takes Guatemala City, ending the civil war
Rafael Carrera’s rebels enter Guatemala City; three states secede
Carrera defeats Morazán at Guatemala City
Morazán is executed in San José, Costa Rica

f.predecessor: First Mexican Empire; Captaincy General of Guatemala
f.successor: Guatemala; El Salvador; Honduras; Nicaragua; Costa Rica
